prompt: What objective do decoder-only LLMs commonly use during pretraining?
explanation: Decoder-only LLMs commonly train to predict the next token.

prompt: Write the next-token negative log likelihood objective.
explanation: Language modeling minimizes negative log probability of next tokens.
